ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the NCHFP, eggs are a low-acid food (pH 6.4–9.0); in pickled eggs, vinegar may not reach every part of the egg.
According to the NCHFP, never keep pickled eggs at room temperature except when serving, and then for no more than 2 hours in the 40–140 °F zone.
